trace.final:
All done:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was its only unhealthy production release; v2.3.1-rc was only in staging).
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action.
4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
